# topnav

The top navigation of the playproject site: logo and section links.

## usage

```js
const STATE = require('STATE')
const statedb = STATE(__filename)
const { get } = statedb(defaults)
const net = require('net_helper')
const topnav = require('topnav')

module.exports = page

async function page (opts) {
  const { id, sdb } = await get(opts.sid)
  const { io, _ } = net(id)
  io.on = { topnav: onmessage_from_topnav }
  const subs = await sdb.watch(onbatch)
  const sub = subs.find(sub => sub.type.endsWith('>topnav'))
  const el = await topnav({ ...sub }, io.invite('topnav', { app: id }))
  _.topnav('scroll', {}) // scroll it into view
  return el

  function onbatch (batch) {}
  function onmessage_from_topnav (msg) {
    if (msg.type === 'jump') console.log('go to', msg.data.to)
  }
}

function defaults () {
  return {
    api,
    _: { net_helper: { $: '' }, topnav: { $: '' } }
  }
  function api () {
    return {
      _: {
        net_helper: { 0: '' },
        topnav: { 0: '', mapping: { style: 'style', content: 'content' } }
      },
      drive: { 'style/': {}, 'content/': {} }
    }
  }
}
```

`src/app.js` uses it the same way as the page root.

## invite

Expects one protocol in its invite: `app`, the page that owns the sections.

- sends `jump` with `{ to }`: a link was clicked, `to` is the section name (`top` for the logo)
- receives `scroll`: scroll itself into view

## drive

- `style/topnav.css`
- `content/topnav.json`: `{ links: [{ id, text, url }] }`
